ci_evidence_policy: Use completed workflow p17-owner-scan-exceptions.yml on the exact commit. File presence is not test evidence.
scope: Owner operation/header/identity contract and least-privilege reservation projection. No P17 endpoint or writer; UI, live and hardware acceptance remain separate.

transport.authorization: Bearer access token through the existing owner auth transport
transport.trace_request_id: HTTP trace only, not Idempotency-Key or client_event_id

headers.If-Match: quoted 0 for creation; quoted observed version for update

operations.version_policy: Returns inspected draft version; does not increment for a check.

headers.If-Match: quoted 0 for creation; quoted observed version for update

validation_projection.resolved: optional; never manufacture IDs for unresolved rows
validation_projection.message: optional; do not require a message on every reason-coded row
validation_projection.accepted_set: Rejected/duplicate events must not overwrite previously accepted entries.

outbound.business_denial: HTTP 200 with eligible_for_outbound=false is not acceptance.
outbound.alias_warning: ALREADY_MATCHED is not the observed owner response code; use ITEM_ALREADY_MATCHED.
outbound.unknown_identity: Keep 4xx error separate; do not fabricate item identity or available_qty=0.

related_document.implemented_patch: Hide reservation identity unless a fresh ACTIVE actor has outbound.view and access to the RESERVING document warehouse.
related_document.can_open_policy: Observed read capability, not a guarantee a later GET succeeds. Recheck owner GET before opening; do not reuse across actor/session/warehouse changes.
related_document.redacted_reservation: Non-null object with redacted=true, can_open=false; still blocks eligibility.
related_document.no_reservation: null only when database query found no reservation.
related_document.cache: private, no-store on successful resolve responses
related_document.error_path: The same projection is used in owner strict rejection details.reserved_by; hidden holds remain non-null.
related_document.rbac_invalidation: Existing AuthCache per-user version invalidation remains authoritative; reread the ACTIVE actor before projection.

nfc.provenance: Nullable historical provenance must not be replaced by current warehouse/actor.

recovery.null_404_policy: Never infer definitive NOT_RECORDED from null/404.
recovery.receipt_vs_current: Historical receipt/response status and version are distinct from current document status/version.
recovery.timeout: Check original owner receipt only; do not send a new RECORD request or key automatically.
recovery.mode_policy: P04 typed scoped and P05 P03-linked only; no P03 reconcile fallback for standalone/legacy record.
recovery.reauth_policy: Refresh preserves auth_session_id. A new login creates a new auth_session_id and never automatically rebinds an old receipt, even for the same actor/warehouse.

collection_policy.allowed: Owner read/validate only, explicitly authorized. No P17 collection may record, save, cancel, prepare, confirm, release or post stock.

remaining: Owner/FE acceptance of integration wiring; no automatic approval from source/CI
Successful dedicated workflow on the exact release commit, separate from full release gates
Release/schema evidence and authorized live read/validate smoke
FE callback/cache/session isolation and device bridge/UAT
Owner-approved retry proof/policy if negative receipts are needed
